points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 朱熹出生于福建尤溪，父亲朱松是南宋官员。幼年时期，朱熹展现出非凡的智力，四岁便能识字，五岁入学。父亲朱松亲自教导他儒家经典，并为他启蒙。1138年，朱松调任泉州，朱熹随父迁居。这段时期，朱熹奠定了深厚的儒学基础，并对佛道思想产生初步接触，为其后来的思想发展埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Youxi, Fujian, Zhu Xi's father Zhu Song was an official of the Southern Song Dynasty. As a child, Zhu Xi showed extraordinary intelligence, learning to recognize characters at age four and entering school at five. His father personally taught him Confucian classics and provided his early education. In 1138, Zhu Song was transferred to Quanzhou, and Zhu Xi moved with him. During this period, Zhu Xi laid a solid foundation in Confucian studies and had initial contact with Buddhist and Taoist thoughts, which would influence his later philosophical development.

points.title: 求学问道
points.description: 1143年，朱松去世，临终前嘱托朱熹跟随著名理学家刘子翚、胡宪等人学习。朱熹在崇安跟随这些名师学习儒家经典，同时深入研究佛道思想。1153年，朱熹拜程颐的四传弟子罗从彦为师，正式进入理学传承体系。这一时期，朱熹广泛阅读，博采众长，形成了自己的学术思想雏形，为后来的理学体系奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1143, Zhu Song passed away, entrusting Zhu Xi to study under famous Neo-Confucian scholars Liu Zihui and Hu Xian. In Chong'an, Zhu Xi studied Confucian classics under these masters while delving deeply into Buddhist and Taoist thoughts. In 1153, Zhu Xi became a disciple of Luo Congyan, the fourth-generation disciple of Cheng Yi, formally entering the Neo-Confucian tradition. During this period, Zhu Xi extensively read and synthesized various ideas, forming the embryonic form of his philosophical system that would later become the foundation of his Neo-Confucianism.

points.title: 著书立说
points.description: 1158年，朱熹开始在建阳讲学，并在此地完成了《四书章句集注》的初稿。这一时期，朱熹系统整理和研究儒家经典，特别是《大学》《中庸》《论语》《孟子》四书，并为之作注解。1167年，朱熹与陆九渊在鹅湖寺进行著名的'鹅湖之会'，就'理'与'心'的关系展开辩论。1178年，朱熹被任命为知南康军，开始在江西推行教化，并修复白鹿洞书院，使其成为理学教育的重要基地。
points.descriptionEn: Starting in 1158, Zhu Xi began teaching in Jianyang and completed the first draft of his 'Collected Commentaries on the Four Books'. During this period, he systematically organized and studied Confucian classics, particularly the 'Great Learning', 'Doctrine of the Mean', 'Analects', and 'Mencius', providing commentaries on them. In 1167, Zhu Xi engaged in the famous 'Ehu Meeting' with Lu Jiuyuan, debating the relationship between 'Principle' (Li) and 'Mind' (Xin). In 1178, Zhu Xi was appointed as the administrator of Nankang Army, where he began promoting education in Jiangxi and restored the Bailongdong Academy, making it an important center for Neo-Confucian education.

points.title: 讲学授徒
points.description: 1179年，朱熹回到崇安，专心讲学授徒。他在武夷山建立了'武夷精舍'，吸引了众多学者前来求学。这一时期，朱熹的理学思想逐渐成熟，形成了完整的体系。他提出了'理一分殊'的宇宙观，强调'格物致知'的认识论，以及'存天理，灭人欲'的道德修养论。朱熹的弟子众多，包括蔡元定、黄榦等著名学者，他们继承和发展了朱熹的学说，形成了'闽学'学派。朱熹的著作如《近思录》《朱子语类》等也在这一时期完成或整理。
points.descriptionEn: In 1179, Zhu Xi returned to Chong'an to focus on teaching. He established the 'Wuyi Academy' in Wuyi Mountain, attracting numerous scholars to study. During this period, Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucian thought gradually matured into a complete system. He proposed the cosmological view of 'Principle as One, Manifestations as Many', emphasized the epistemology of 'Investigating Things to Extend Knowledge', and the moral cultivation theory of 'Preserving Heavenly Principle, Eliminating Human Desires'. Zhu Xi had many disciples, including famous scholars like Cai Yuanding and Huang Gan, who inherited and developed his teachings, forming the 'Min School' of Neo-Confucianism. His works such as 'Reflections on Things at Hand' and 'Classified Conversations of Master Zhu' were completed or compiled during this period.

points.title: 晚年著述
points.description: 1194年，朱熹再次回到建阳，专注于著述和讲学。这一时期，他完成了《四书章句集注》的最终修订，这部著作后来成为元明清三代科举考试的官方指定教材，影响了中国近七百年的教育。1196年，朱熹因'伪学'之祸被弹劾，学说被斥为'伪学'，本人也被贬官。尽管如此，朱熹仍坚持讲学不辍。1199年，朱熹开始编纂《仪礼经传通解》，这是他对儒家礼仪制度的重要研究。1200年，朱熹在建阳逝世，享年71岁。他的理学思想在他去世后得到广泛传播，成为官方哲学，对中国乃至东亚文化产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1194, Zhu Xi returned to Jianyang again, focusing on writing and teaching. During this period, he completed the final revision of 'Collected Commentaries on the Four Books', which later became the official textbook for imperial examinations during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties, influencing Chinese education for nearly 700 years. In 1196, Zhu Xi was impeited due to the 'False Learning' incident, his teachings were denounced as 'false learning', and he was demoted. Despite this, Zhu Xi continued to teach without interruption. In 1199, Zhu Xi began compiling the 'Comprehensive Explanation of the Rites and Their Transmission', an important study of Confucian ritual systems. In 1200, Zhu Xi passed away in Jianyang at the age of 71. His Neo-Confucian thought spread widely after his death, becoming official philosophy and exerting profound influence on Chinese and even East Asian culture.

appraisal.zh: 朱熹是宋明理学的集大成者，融会儒释道而构建系统哲学，其《四书章句集注》成为科举标准，塑造中国士人近千年，并远播朝鲜、日本，书院教育亦贡献显著。另一种看法认为，他过分强调天理与人欲的对立而流于禁欲，格物之说被后世僵化理解，晚年卷入政治斗争使学说沦为工具，某些观点也带有时代偏见，因此需辩证看待。
appraisal.en: Zhu Xi is the great synthesizer of Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism, integrating Confucian, Buddhist and Taoist thought into a systematic philosophy; his commentaries on the Four Books became the examination standard, shaping Chinese literati for nearly a millennium and spreading to Korea and Japan, with notable contributions to academy education. Another view holds that his sharp opposition of Heavenly Principle and human desire tended toward asceticism, that his method of investigating things was later rigidly interpreted, and that his late-life political entanglements made his teachings a tool, while some views carry the biases of their age.

supporter.zh: 朱熹是中国历史上最伟大的哲学家之一，他集北宋理学之大成，构建了系统完备的理学体系。他的'格物致知'、'存天理，灭人欲'等思想深刻影响了后世中国人的价值观和道德观。朱熹整理注释的《四书》成为科举考试的标准教材，塑造了中国近千年的知识分子。他重视教育，创办书院，培养了大批人才，对中国文化传承做出了不可磨灭的贡献。朱熹的理学思想不仅在中国，还在朝鲜、日本等东亚国家广泛传播，成为东亚文化圈的重要组成部分。
supporter.en: Zhu Xi stands as one of China's greatest philosophers, who synthesized the achievements of Northern Song Neo-Confucianism and constructed a systematic and complete philosophical system. His concepts of 'Investigating Things to Extend Knowledge' and 'Preserving Heavenly Principle, Eliminating Human Desires' profoundly influenced later Chinese values and moral concepts. His annotated 'Four Books' became the standard textbook for imperial examinations, shaping Chinese intellectuals for nearly a millennium. Zhu Xi emphasized education, established academies, and cultivated numerous talents, making indelible contributions to Chinese cultural heritage. His Neo-Confucianism spread not only in China but also in Korea, Japan, and other East Asian countries, becoming an essential part of the East Asian cultural sphere.

critic.zh: 朱熹的理学思想也存在明显的历史局限性。他过分强调'天理'与'人欲'的对立，导致对人性压抑和禁欲倾向，被批评为'存天理，灭人欲'的极端化。他的'格物致知'方法被后世僵化理解，限制了科学思维的发展。朱熹对佛道的批判有时过于简单化，忽视了其中的合理成分。此外，朱熹晚年卷入政治斗争，其学说被用作政治工具，失去了部分学术独立性。他的某些观点如'女子无才便是德'等，也体现了封建时代的性别偏见，受到现代批评。
critic.en: Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism also has clear historical limitations. He overemphasized the opposition between 'Heavenly Principle' and 'Human Desires', leading to repression of human nature and ascetic tendencies, criticized as the extreme of 'Preserving Heavenly Principle, Eliminating Human Desires'. His method of 'Investigating Things to Extend Knowledge' was later rigidly interpreted, limiting the development of scientific thinking. Zhu Xi's criticisms of Buddhism and Taoism were sometimes overly simplistic, neglecting their reasonable elements. Additionally, Zhu Xi became involved in political struggles in his later years, and his teachings were used as political tools, losing some academic independence. Some of his views, such as 'A woman without talent is virtuous', reflect feudal gender biases and are criticized in modern times.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，朱熹是宋明理学的集大成者，他的思想融合了儒家、佛道思想，形成了具有中国特色的哲学体系。在流行文化中，朱熹常被塑造为传统儒家文化的象征，代表着重视道德修养、家庭伦理和社会秩序的传统价值观。他的《四书章句集注》至今仍是研究儒家思想的重要文本。朱熹的理学思想既是中国传统文化的精华，也包含着时代局限性，需要辩证看待。作为一位教育家，朱熹对书院教育的贡献不可忽视，他提倡的'读书法'和'修身法'对现代教育仍有启示意义。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Zhu Xi was the great synthesizer of Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism, whose philosophy integrated Confucian, Buddhist, and Taoist thoughts, forming a philosophical system with Chinese characteristics. In popular culture, Zhu Xi is often portrayed as a symbol of traditional Confucian culture, representing traditional values that emphasize moral cultivation, family ethics, and social order. His 'Collected Commentaries on the Four Books' remains an important text for studying Confucian thought. Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism contains both the essence of traditional Chinese culture and its historical limitations, requiring a dialectical perspective. As an educator, Zhu Xi's contributions to academy education are noteworthy, and his methods of 'reading' and 'self-cultivation' still offer insights for modern education.

self.zh: 为学须是先立大本，其初甚约，中间甚广，其终甚高。
self.en: In learning, one must first establish the great foundation. In the beginning, it is very simple; in the middle, it becomes very broad; at the end, it becomes very sublime.
